items.title: TDB-DST signs agreement with BigEndian Semiconductors for ₹130 crore RDI support to develop indigenous AI Vision SoC
items.summary: Strengthening India’s efforts to build indigenous semiconductor capabilities for critical and emerging applications, the Technology Development Board (TDB), Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, has signed an agreement with M/s BigEndian Semiconductors, Bengaluru, Karnataka for financial…
key_facts: The project, Project VeerAI, has a total project cost of ₹260 crore and aims to take the technology from Technology Readiness Level (TRL)-5 to TRL-9.
The technology is being developed initially for CCTV and surveillance applications in India and the Global South, with a roadmap for deployment across multiple sectors.

Through the RDI support, BigEndian Semiconductors will undertake further technology development, validation, integration, testing and scale-up activities required to progress Project VeerAI from TRL-5 to TRL-9.

items.title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the qualities of a noble-hearted person
items.summary: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting that purity of heart, a spirit of sacrifice, courage, equanimity in joy and sorrow, competence, affection and truthfulness are the defining qualities of a noble-hearted person and an exceptional personality.

items.title: UCIL Celebrates Diamond Jubilee Year, Marks Six Decades of India’s Uranium Mining and Processing Capability
items.summary: The Uranium Corporation of India Limited (UCIL), a Public Sector Enterprise under the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), celebrated its Diamond Jubilee Year on 4 October 2026, marking six decades of its journey in uranium mining and processing and its contribution at the forefront of India’s nuclear power programme.
key_facts: It is also an occasion to pay respectful homage to Dr Homi Jehangir Bhabha and the pioneers who laid the foundations of India’s uranium mining and processing capabilities.

Over these six decades, generations of UCIL personnel have demonstrated remarkable dedication and grit, working in challenging conditions and environments to sustain this important national endeavour.
It is also an occasion to pay respectful homage to Dr Homi Jehangir Bhabha and the pioneers who laid the foundations of India’s uranium mining and processing capabilities.

items.title: Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh Underscores India’s Rising Maritime Power, Indigenous Naval Capability and Strategic Strength at Barakhana in Visakhapatnam
items.summary: Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh attended a Barakhana organised by the Eastern Naval Command in Visakhapatnam on October 05, 2026 and interacted with Indian Navy personnel and their families.
key_facts: He conveyed his continued support to the personnel and their families and recognised their commitment and contribution towards national security.
Recalling the Navy’s glorious record of valour, he referred to its decisive role during the 1971 War, particularly Operation Trident, when Indian naval forces struck Karachi harbour.

He said the operation demonstrated the Navy’s capability not only to safeguard India’s maritime frontiers but also to project power and undertake offensive operations against the adversary when required.

items.title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA HOSTS PRESIDENT OF THE SWISS CONFEDERATION
items.summary: The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu received H.E. Mr Guy Parmelin, President of the Swiss Confederation at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (October 5, 2026). She also hosted a banquet in his honour.
key_facts: The two leaders agreed that close cooperation between India and Switzerland can bring immense benefits to the people of both countries.

items.title: 2nd Prof. (Dr.) N. R. Madhava Menon Memorial Lecture Held at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre
items.summary: The Dr. Ambedkar International Centre (DAIC), in collaboration with the Commonwealth Legal Education Association (CLEA), organised the 2nd Prof (Dr.) N. R. Madhava Menon Memorial Lecture at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre in National Capital here, this evening.
key_facts: On the occasion, the Chief Justice of India released two significant publications in the field of law — ‘Indian Personal Law: Unity and Diversity’ and ‘Economics and Law in Context’.
The books were introduced by Mr. Gowrishankar Natesan, Publisher, Thomson Reuters and Chief Executive Officer, Southshore Innovations Private Limited; Ms.
Nabila Zehra, Assistant Professor, School of Law, SGT University, Gurugram; and Dr. Sougata Talukdar, Assistant Professor in Law, Government Centre of Legal Education, University of Burdwan.

items.title: MoHUA celebrates World Habitat Day 2026 with focus on advancing affordable, resilient and Inclusive housing
items.summary: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) celebrated World Habitat Day 2026 on the theme ‘Adequate Housing for All’ with a focus on strengthening the urban housing ecosystem through innovation, policy reforms, technology and sustainable financing.
key_facts: The guest of honour for the event was Shri Tokhan Sahu, Hon’ble Minister of State for Housing & Urban Affairs.
The event showcased the progress and diverse approaches being adopted towards achieving the objective of “Housing for All”, including best practices under PMAY-U and PMAY-U 2.0.
This annual recognition will further encourage healthy competition, promote best practices and inspire stakeholders to strengthen the delivery of affordable and quality housing across the country.

Scindia today visited the India Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026 venue at Yashobhoomi, Dwarka, to review final preparations ahead of its inauguration Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi on October 8th, 2026.

items.title: India and Japan Launch Operational Manual for the Joint Crediting Mechanism
items.summary: On 30th September, 2026, Ambassador of Japan to India, H.E. Mr. Keiichi Ono and the then Secretary (MoEFCC), Shri Tanmay Kumar, jointly launched the Operational Manual for the India–Japan Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM), in New Delhi.

items.title: Ministry of Textiles Organises Swachhta and Cleanliness Activities on Gandhi Jayanti under Special Campaign 6
items.summary: The Ministry of Textiles observed Gandhi Jayanti on 2 October 2026 with a series of Swachhta and cleanliness activities under Special Campaign 6.0, reaffirming its commitment to promoting cleanliness, hygiene and a culture of responsible workplace practices.
key_facts: The programme was led by Secretary (Textiles) at the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT), Delhi, and was attended by senior officers of the Ministry of Textiles, faculty members and staff of NIFT Delhi.
A cleanliness drive was also undertaken at the NIFT Delhi campus, with active participation of officers, faculty and staff.

Textile Waste Collection Drive starting this Gandhi Jayanti As part of the initiative, starting this Gandhi Jayanti, 2nd October 2026, a dedicated textile waste collection bins have been installed at various locations.

items.title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA TO VISIT HIMACHAL PRADESH FROM OCTOBER 6 TO 8
items.summary: The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu will visit Himachal Pradesh from October 6 to 8, 2026. On October 6, the President will grace the first convocation of AIIMS Bilaspur in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh. On October 7, the President will visit Atal Tunnel, Rohtang, Lahaul – Spiti district.

items.title: CAQM intensifies field-level monitoring with deployment of Flying Squads to prevent paddy stubble burning incidents in Punjab and Haryana
items.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management in NCR and Adjoining Areas (CAQM) has further intensified its coordinated field-level monitoring mechanism for prevention and control of paddy stubble burning incidents in Punjab and Haryana.
items.ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
key_facts: The deployment covers 18 districts in Punjab and 16 districts in Haryana, providing extensive field-level monitoring across the two States during the critical paddy harvesting period.
In Haryana, the deployment covers Jind, Fatehabad, Hisar, Kaithal, Sonipat, Rohtak, Sirsa, Karnal, Palwal, Jhajjar, Kurukshetra, Ambala, Yamunanagar, Faridabad, Panipat and Hansi.

items.title: IICA observed 3rd IICA CSR Day on Gandhi Jayanti with a Special Address by the DG & CEO to Participants of the IICA Certified CSR Professional Programme ahead of NCCSR 2026
items.summary: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), under the aegis of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India, observed CSR Day recently on the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.
key_facts: The session, organised virtually by the School of Business Environment, IICA, also served as the curtain-raiser to the 3rd National Conference and Exhibition on Corporate Social Responsibility (NCCSR 2026).

The observance draws on a suggestion made by the then Hon'ble President of India, Shri Ram Nath Kovind, at the National CSR Awards in 2019, that 2nd October be dedicated to Corporate Social Responsibility.
She emphasised that the programme has been linked with the National Conference as part of its curriculum for this purpose, and informed that NCCSR 2026 has drawn over 550 delegates from across India.

items.title: Appointment of Additional Judge of the Delhi High Court
items.summary: In exercise of the power conferred by the Constitution of India, after consultation with Chief Justice of India, the President is pleased to appoint Shri Gurvinder Pal Singh, Judicial Officer as an Additional Judge of the Delhi High Court.

items.title: Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi to Inaugurate Windergy India 2026 in Chennai
items.summary: Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy, Education and Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Shri Pralhad Joshi, will inaugurate the 8th edition of Windergy India on October 8th, 2026, at the Chennai Trade Centre, setting in motion India's premier wind energy show.

key_facts: The inauguration will feature global MoU announcements and the launch of key sectoral reports, alongside recognition of states demonstrating leadership in the wind energy sector.
India added a record 6.05 GW of wind capacity in FY2025-26, with cumulative capacity reaching 58.52 GW by August 2026.
With 28 GW under implementation supporting the goal of 100 GW by 2030.

items.title: From Unemployment to Self-Reliance
items.summary: Financial assistance can play an important role in helping individuals from disadvantaged communities establish sustainable livelihoods and improve their economic condition.
key_facts: Shri Durgesh Barkhane, a resident of Junardev, Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh, was selected under the NSFDC Electric Auto-Rickshaw Subsidy Scheme, 2024 and received financial assistance of Rs. 1,85,000.
With the financial assistance received under the scheme, he purchased an auto-rickshaw for approximately Rs. 15,000–20,000 and began earning through its operation.
The assistance has provided Shri Durgesh with an opportunity to pursue self-employment and move towards greater financial stability.

key_facts: Ramasubramanian and Members, Justice (Dr.) Bidyut Ranjan Sarangi and Smt. Vijaya Bharathi Sayani will hear cases in the Full Commission sitting in the presence of complainants and concerned officers of the State.
The next day, on 8th October 2026, the Commission will hear cases in two separate Benches.
The Chairperson will hear cases of alleged bonded labour.

items.title: From Financial Constraints to Academic Aspirations
items.summary: Financial support can play an important role in enabling students from disadvantaged communities to pursue higher education and realise their academic aspirations.
key_facts: Timely fellowship assistance can help overcome financial barriers, strengthen educational opportunities and encourage greater participation in advanced studies.
Her fellowship assistance began in September 2019 and included Fellowship, House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Contingency support.
She received approximately Rs. 18 lakh under the scheme, which helped her pursue her Ph.D. and overcome the financial constraints associated with higher education.
